request: Release Tip Jar (TIPS): an ERC-20 with a fixed total supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens and 18 decimals and a TipJar contract that forwards ETH tips to a recipient, with invariant tests and an independent review; deploy both on Sepolia; then publish a one-page site to tip and read totals.
context: Sepolia only. GitHub and IPFS approved. Site name tip-jar. No owner, no admin, no upgrade.

draft.objective: Build TIPS and TipJar with tests and a review, deploy them, then build the tipping page against the live deployment.

steps.objective: TipsToken and TipJar with a Foundry project.
acceptanceCriteria: TipJar never holds ETH after a tip

steps.objective: Invariant and fuzz tests for TipJar.
Connect a wallet, tip in ETH, show the recipient's total.
